definitions.gloss: iaijutsu; the art of drawing the sword
definitions.explanation: The martial art of drawing the sword from its scabbard and cutting in a single motion, practised today mostly as solo forms (kata) with a real or blunt blade.

examples.japanese: {居合|いあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{居合|いあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandfather is a master of iaijutsu.

examples.japanese: {居合|いあい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{斬|き}る→斬る：28974_kiru⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧になっている。
examples.english: In iaijutsu, drawing the sword and cutting are a single movement.

notes:
Written {居合|いあい} or {居合|いあ}い. The practice as a modern martial way is usually called ⟦{居合道|いあいどう}→居合道：17631_iaidou⟧; {居合|いあい} itself names the technique and the older art.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {居合|いあい}{斬|ぎ}り: a sword-drawing cut (also a demonstration cutting rolled mats)
- {居合|いあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧: a master of iaijutsu
- {居合|いあい}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧: a quick-draw sword performance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧: fencing with bamboo swords and armour against a partner; {居合|いあい} is practised alone, with a sword in a scabbard.
